user.title: Trybatec account
user.description: Enter the credentials for the Trybatec portal and the UUID from your portal's /indexes/ page URL. This is an unofficial integration.

data.deal_id: Deal ID (UUID from the Indexes page URL)

error.cannot_connect: Unable to retrieve data from Trybatec.
error.invalid_deal_id: The deal ID must be a UUID.

abort.already_configured: This Trybatec account and deal are already configured.

settings.title: Trybatec options
settings.description: Tariffs are estimates. Verify each meter in 'Verify meter units'. The legacy global heating-unit option is no longer used.

history_review.title: Choose a reading for review
history_review.description:
Run trybatec.preview_history first. Only readings from the latest preview appear.

[Open Settings → Tools → Actions]({actions_url})

history_decision.title: Reading decision
history_decision.description: Original Trybatec reading remains unchanged. Decision is stored locally.

history_correction.title: Correct or attribute a reading
history_correction.description: Only correct measurement date with evidence. Accounting attribution is a convention, not a measurement timestamp.

data.back_to_decision: Revenir au choix de la décision

history_confirm.title: Confirm reading decision

data.confirm_outside_period: I explicitly confirm the attribution outside the observed interval
data.back_to_decision: Revenir au choix de la décision

meter_units.title: Select meter
meter_units.description: Portal-reported and individually confirmed units. Retired meters appear after a history preview.

meter_unit.title: Meter index unit
meter_unit.description: Meter: {meter}. Unit reported by portal: {portal_unit}. Verify the INDEX unit, not just manufacturer specifications. Conflicts disable statistics.

history_overview.title: Historical preflight
history_overview.description:
Period: {period}. Meters: {meters}. Readings flagged: {flagged}.\n{details}\nDistinct physical meters are never automatically merged. Import through the admin action trybatec.import_history.

[Open Settings → Tools → Actions]({actions_url})

history_empty.title: No readings to review
history_empty.description:
No reading currently needs a decision, or the preview is unavailable.

Run `trybatec.preview_history` in Tools, then return here.

[Open Settings → Tools → Actions]({actions_url})

error.invalid_tariffs: Invalid tariff JSON. See the example.
error.invalid_review_correction: Invalid or ambiguous date/time (daylight saving change).
error.conflicting_meter_unit: Chosen unit conflicts with the explicit portal value.

abort.history_preview_required: First run a new history preview from Developer Tools → Actions.
